answer: You can starve a sybil farm by front-loading its costs. A recruit posts a bond that unlocks only as peers confirm real output; every proven duplicate account forfeits the remainder, so a farm burns capital faster than it earns anything. In effect the ferrous of free entry disappears, the lotus of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the pigment case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm.
